title: We should defer the PWA install banner until after the cookie banner.
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
When a new user visits the site, we show the cookie banner and the app install banner at the same time. Because they overlap, the add to homescreen banner actually covers the ok/more info cookies buttons.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Defer the add to home screen banner until after the user has accepted cookies.
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
